# Vendored LLDB 4.0.1 headers

These are the public LLDB headers from the LLDB 4.0.1 release, vendored so the
baseline bridge can be compiled without a machine-specific LLDB SDK checkout.
Only the header tree is included; the server never links this copy.

The files carry their upstream LLVM license notices (Apache License v2.0 with
LLVM Exceptions). See <https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt>.
